text:
paul_csm: Heads-up — onboarding batch for BrightApps cohort failed during embeddings step (~11:02 UTC). Customers saw 503s. I'm compiling impacted accounts now.

amanda_cs: ugh. rough timing for them. are any in trial/renewal window?

paul_csm: 6 accounts impacted, 2 on trial, 1 renewal in 18 days (Stripe reminder sent). Most are mid-onboarding — assets already uploaded.

rahul_se: digging into logs — embedding service returned 502 from provider node, our retry loop misclassified as success and bubbled 503 to client. Fix is small: expand retry window + mark transient errors correctly. I can patch runtime later today.

opsbot: Incident detected: embeddings-service-502s at 2026-03-15T11:02Z. Auto-retry attempted 3 times. Incident ID: INC-1138.

jess_support: we should send an initial status update ASAP. simple note: acknowledge, mitigation in progress, ETA for patch, support contact.

maria_onboard: agree — onboarding customers need reassurance and an offer to reschedule sessions. can we include a one-time onboarding session + credit?

amanda_cs: propose: 25% service credit for the failed window + complimentary 1-hour onboarding workshop (live) for trial/onboarding customers. For the renewal-risk account, offer account review + 50% credit if they express churn intent. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

paul_csm: sounds reasonable. keep messages concise. I'll draft outbound template and schedule 1:1 outreach for the renewal account.

jess_support: I'll queue a support case per account and ping customers to set expectations.

rahul_se: ETA for patch: I can push a safe fix to canary in ~90m, full rollout in 3h if canary looks good. We'll add a short-term traffic diversion to healthy embedding replicas to reduce impact immediately.

opsbot: Deploy pipeline: canary job started by rahul_se at 2026-03-15T12:35Z. Watch logs for errors.

paul_csm: Draft outbound (please iterate):
```
Hi <Customer Name>,

We wanted to let you know about an incident that affected some onboarding jobs earlier today. Some embedding requests returned errors which caused failures for a subset of uploads. Our engineers have identified the root cause and are applying a patch now.

What we're doing:
- Immediate mitigation: traffic routed to healthy replicas and extra retries enabled.
- Short-term fix: rolling patch to canary then full rollout (ETA ~3 hours).
- Customer support: we'll reschedule any interrupted onboarding steps and offer a 1-hour live onboarding session.
- Credit: a one-time service credit for the affected window (25%).

If you'd like a dedicated call, reply and we'll arrange it. We're sorry for the disruption.

— The Redwood Inference Team
```

amanda_cs: good. add sentence: "No sensitive data was exposed; this was a transient infrastructure error."

paul_csm: updated draft and tagging affected list. I'll send the email within 30m after Rahul confirms canary looks stable.

maria_onboard: I'll prepare scheduling links for onboarding sessions and a short checklist we can attach.

jess_support: I'll create support tickets and include the draft message. tagging customers with high-touch flag for CSM follow-up.

rahul_se: Canary health looks clean after 25m, error rate down to baseline. Proceed with rollout.

opsbot: INC-1138 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Root cause: retry logic misclassification + transient embedding node failures.

paul_csm: Sending outbound now. Follow-ups: Amanda will handle trial customers; I will reach the renewal-risk account; Maria will schedule onboarding sessions; Jess will log credits in billing queue. Thanks team :thumbsup:

amanda_cs: thanks — will share notes from renewal call if we get them.

jess_support: tickets created: #CS-7192 through #CS-7197. billing notified for credits.

paul_csm: Closing thread here but will post final RCA once engineering completes root-cause writeup.

rahul_se: I'll drop the detailed RCA in eng-postmortems channel later today with stack traces and diff.

paul_csm: perfect.
